combined_rows.label: HMMER alignment preparation
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Alignment/model measurements, mask/map relationships and validation; no gene-function confidence.

combined_rows.label: HMMER artifact preparation
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Decoded model/key/artifact counts, probability-body differences where decoded, and custody/format checks; opaque content remains unknown.

combined_rows.label: HMMER generated sequences
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Generated sequence composition, counts, alignment quantities and consensus checks; not observed biological evidence.

combined_rows.label: HMMER score simulation
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Native and independently fitted random-score distribution quantities with their selected populations.

combined_rows.label: HMMER model statistics
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Native model statistics and explicit-parameter recalculation; missing background is unavailable.

combined_rows.label: HMMER FM index and literal matches
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: Index/source populations and literal-location/count validation; raw FM intervals are distinct from validated source matches.

combined_rows.label: Infernal preparation (one shared sheet, three branches)
combined_rows.numerical_meaning: 18 statistics/generated-data modes plus 9 artifact-validation modes; the latter compute counts/bytes and checks, not scientific-confidence scores. Branches are not extra independent analyses.
